brief: A short, upbeat explainer for people new to gardening on how a home compost pile turns kitchen scraps into soil. Cover the four things it needs: green scraps, brown material such as dry leaves, air, and a little moisture; tiny organisms do the rest. End by noting that turning the pile now and then speeds it up.
